deterministic.product_description: Rear lamp  — exterior lighting & signalling module combining multiple light functions, lens, and retro-reflector in a single housing.
deterministic.vehicle_category_note: M1 — passenger car. UNECE lighting regulations referenced apply across M and N categories.

parts.name: Rear position lamp
parts.function: Emits red light to the rear to indicate the presence and width of the vehicle
parts.material: LED modules on PCB; reflector surface PC with aluminium vacuum-metallised coating
parts.evidence_drawing: The upper view (lens removed) shows a row of 8 small circular emitters above the reflector-cup array and an elongated strip-shaped optic at top right. Either may serve the position function; the drawing does not label them.

parts.name: Stop lamp
parts.function: Emits higher-intensity red light to the rear to indicate service-brake application
parts.material: LED modules on PCB; reflector surface PC with aluminium vacuum-metallised coating
parts.evidence_drawing: The upper view shows an array of 24 faceted reflector cups (3 rows x 8 columns) in the left compartment. This is likely the multi-LED stop or position light section; assignment is not labelled.

parts.name: Reversing lamp
parts.function: Illuminates the road to the rear and warns other road users that the vehicle is reversing (white light)
parts.material: LED modules on PCB; reflector surface PC with aluminium vacuum-metallised coating
parts.evidence_drawing: The upper view shows a separate rectangular compartment at lower right with a faceted (pillow-optic) reflector and a semicircular element. In the lower view, this matches a rectangular vertically-ribbed lens zone.

parts.name: Outer lens
parts.function: Transmits light, defines colour of emitted light and seals/protects the optical chamber; forms outer surface of the lamp
parts.regulated_function: lens (of a lamp); outer surface relevant to external projections
parts.evidence_drawing: The lower view shows a full-cover outer lens with diagonal transparency hatching and a distinct rectangular ribbed optical zone at lower right.

parts.name: Retro-reflector
parts.function: Reflects incident light back toward its source for passive conspicuity of the vehicle rear
parts.evidence_drawing: Not clearly identifiable. A plain rectangular recessed compartment in the centre of the upper view may house it, but no prism pattern is drawn.

parts.name: Housing
parts.function: Structural body carrying the optical compartments, light sources and lens; mounting interface to vehicle body
parts.evidence_drawing: The upper view shows the housing with peripheral flange and internal partition walls separating the lighting compartments.

parts.name: Reflector surface
parts.function: Collects and directs LED light into the required photometric distribution
parts.evidence_spec: | Reflector surface | PC with aluminium vacuum-metallised coating |
parts.evidence_drawing: The upper view shows faceted reflector cups in the left array and a faceted reflector in the lower-right compartment.

parts.name: LED modules on PCB
parts.function: Light sources with electronic circuitry (PCB) generating light for all lamp functions
parts.evidence_spec: | Light source      | LED modules on PCB                          |
parts.evidence_drawing: Small circular emitters and reflector-cup array visible in the upper view; PCB itself not shown.

parts.name: Seal / gasket
parts.function: Seals the lens-to-housing joint against water and dust ingress

parts.name: Fasteners / clips
parts.function: Attach the lamp to the vehicle body and/or retain internal parts
parts.evidence_spec: | Fasteners / clips | PA, POM, or steel                           |

electronic_subassemblies: LED modules on PCB (light sources with circuitry for rear position, stop and reversing functions)
model.light_sources: LED modules on PCB. The spec does not state replaceability; presumed non-replaceable LED modules — confirm. If replaceable LED light sources are used, the light-source regulations apply.
regulated_functions: lens (of a lamp); outer surface relevant to external projections
search_terms: installation of lighting and light-signalling devices
drawing_observations: Two views: upper view shows the lamp interior with outer lens removed; lower view shows the assembled outer lens.
Upper left compartment contains 24 faceted reflector cups arranged in 3 rows of 8.
A row of 8 small circular emitters, each in its own segmented cell, sits above the reflector-cup array.
A plain rectangular recessed compartment is located in the centre, function not identified.
An elongated strip-shaped optic or light guide runs along the upper right of the housing.
Lower right has a separate rectangular compartment with a faceted (pillow-optic) reflector and a semicircular element, consistent with the reversing lamp.
Outer lens covers the entire housing; diagonal hatching indicates a transparent surface.
Outer lens has a distinct rectangular, vertically ribbed optical zone at lower right, aligned with the lower-right compartment.
Spec states the outer lens is red-tinted. The reversing lamp zone must emit white light, so verify a clear (non-red) lens section there.
No dedicated prism-pattern retro-reflector area is distinguishable in either view.
Housing has a wraparound shape with a tapered corner profile, typical of a body-side rear combination lamp.
